# Getting paid

Ledgerly sends each invoice with a payment link. Your customer can pay by card
or bank transfer, and you see the payment on the invoice as soon as it clears.

## Send an invoice

1. Select **New invoice**.
2. Choose the customer, add your line items and set a due date.
3. Select **Send**. Ledgerly emails the invoice and a payment link.

## Reminders

Ledgerly reminds your customer 3 days before the due date and again on the day
it is due. Change the schedule in **Settings > Reminders**.
